title: 1.3 Plate Movements and Plate Boundaries
description: Convergent, divergent and transform boundaries, subduction, seafloor spreading and mantle convection. Easy level.

questions.question: What happens at a convergent plate boundary?
options: Two plates slide past each other
It is neither created nor destroyed
Two plates move away from each other
Two plates move toward each other
questions.correctAnswer: Two plates move toward each other

questions.question: What happens at a divergent plate boundary?
options: Two plates move toward each other
It is destroyed and recycled into the mantle
It is neither created nor destroyed
Two plates move away from each other
questions.correctAnswer: Two plates move away from each other

questions.question: What happens at a transform plate boundary?
options: Two plates slide past each other
Two plates move away from each other
Two plates move toward each other
It is neither created nor destroyed
questions.correctAnswer: Two plates slide past each other
